title: 2021 Fall AMC 10B Problem 9
statement: The knights in a certain kingdom come in two colors. \(\frac{2}{7}\) of them are red, and the rest are blue. Furthermore, \(\frac{1}{6}\) of the knights are magical, and the fraction of red knights who are magical is \(2\) times the fraction of blue knights who are magical. What fraction of red knights are magical?

solutions.text:
Let \(x\) be the fraction of blue knights who are magical. Then the fraction of red knights who are magical is \(2x.\)

The total magical fraction is a weighted average over the red and blue groups: \[\frac27(2x)+\frac57(x)=\frac16.\]

Thus \(\frac97x=\frac16,\) so \(x=\frac7{54}.\) The red magical fraction is \(2x=\frac7{27}.\)

Thus, the answer is C .
